clue.text: Advice on clues in anagram form

indicators.note: the clue openly says these letters are to be rearranged, a joke on the solver's own business

explanation.surface: Someone asks for guidance on how to tackle crossword clues that are written as anagrams.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in anagram form' rearranges ON and CLUES together into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Counsel is advice or guidance given, as from a lawyer or wise friend.

clue.text: A decisive point made by criminals in speech

indicators.note: in speech means the word for criminals is said out loud and spelt differently

parts.note: crooks are criminals

explanation.surface: A crucial point is raised by lawbreakers when they speak.
explanation.definitionFit: The crux is the decisive or essential point of a matter.

clue.text: Union leaders firm — that's great for the Scots

parts.note: the leading letters of the word Union, its first two
CO is the abbreviation of company, a firm

explanation.surface: Trade union bosses praise a company, in Scottish dialect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaders' here means the opening pair of letters of 'Union', not just its first.
explanation.definitionFit: In Scots dialect unco means very or remarkable, a crossword-favourite word for great.

clue.text: Settle, or prepare to fight?

definitions.meaning: to pay off what is owed, settling the account
to take up a boxer's stance facing an opponent

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both settling a bill and adopting a fighting posture.

clue.text: Shrub, one that's in rising demand

indicators.note: the numeral for one is said to be in the reversed word, so it sits inside it
in a down clue rising means the word is read upwards, back to front

parts.note: a call is a demand, as in a call for action
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A garden shrub that is increasingly sought after.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns CALL into LLAC; 'that's in' places I after its first L.
explanation.definitionFit: Lilac is a flowering shrub of the olive family, prized for its scented blooms.

clue.text: Barker is a fool to back the outsider

indicators.note: the word for backing a horse is said to be the one outside, so it wraps the other

parts.note: to back a horse is to bet on it
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: At the races, someone betting on the rank outsider is called an idiot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Barker' is a dog, a sense hidden by the racing picture; 'the outsider' says the betting word wraps round the fool.
explanation.definitionFit: A basset is a short-legged hound, and any dog may be called a barker.

clue.text: Partly pebbledash large piece of masonry

indicators.note: partly means only some of the letters of these words are taken, running across them

explanation.surface: A wall partly finished in pebbledash has one large stone block in it.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashlar is a squared, dressed block of building stone used in masonry.

clue.text: Doing without strong drink — it's discouraged

explanation.definitionFit: Read literally it means lacking liquor; as an ordinary word it means listless and dejected.

clue.text: Pay attention, or get warning of dismissal

definitions.meaning: to receive one's notice from an employer

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both to heed something and to receive notice of being sacked.

clue.text: Stumbling upon clue for "disconnect"

indicators.note: stumbling suggests a clumsy, jumbled arrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: Someone happens across a crossword clue whose answer means to disconnect.
explanation.definitionFit: To uncouple is to detach things joined together, such as railway carriages.

clue.text: Contract provided by psychiatrist

definitions.meaning: slang for a head doctor, short for headshrinker

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to contract; as slang the noun means a psychiatrist.

clue.text: Walton's deceptive appearance

definitions.meaning: a work by the composer William Walton, his entertainment of poems by Edith Sitwell
a false front put on to mislead

explanation.definitionFit: Walton composed the entertainment so named, and the word also means a misleading outward show.

clue.text: Announcement from the Roman Capitol

indicators.note: the answer is made from these letters, worked into a new order

explanation.surface: An official decree is issued from the Capitol in ancient Rome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' is a light anagram signal here: the letters of ROMAN CAPITOL rearrange exactly.
explanation.definitionFit: A proclamation is a formal public announcement.

clue.text: First of all, pieces are set out by partner

indicators.note: set out means arranged afresh, so these letters are laid out in a new order

parts.note: an ally is a partner

explanation.surface: Before anything, a player has their chess pieces laid out by a partner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First of all' looks like an instruction to take initial letters, but it is the definition; 'set out' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Especially means above all, in particular, much as first of all does.

clue.text: A succession of small bloomers

parts.note: bloomers suggests underwear or blunders, but means little flowers linked one after another

explanation.definitionFit: A daisy chain is a string of small flowers linked stem to stem, or by extension any linked series.

clue.text: Friends turn up to dinner — an ample feast!

indicators.note: turn means the word for friends is turned round

parts.note: pals are friends
taken as written
dinner is a meal

explanation.surface: Mates arrive for dinner and find a generous spread.
explanation.definitionFit: A slap-up meal is a lavish, plentiful one, an informal British phrase.

clue.text: Composer from Harlem

indicators.note: the answer is made from these letters in a new order

explanation.surface: A musician who comes from Harlem in New York.
explanation.definitionFit: Gustav Mahler was an Austrian composer of symphonies.

clue.text: Set fire to sleeping accommodation in Paris

definitions.meaning: the French word for a bed

explanation.definitionFit: It is the past of to light, and French for bed.

clue.text: Willing scholar comes up to help

indicators.note: in a down clue comes up means the word is read upwards, back to front

parts.note: MA, Master of Arts, is a graduate scholar
to enable is to help

explanation.surface: A learned person shows they are prepared to assist.
explanation.definitionFit: Amenable means open and responsive to suggestion, willing to comply.

clue.text: Typical measures current in Germany

definitions.meaning: typographical units of width in printing, with typical hinting at type
a river flowing through north-west Germany

explanation.definitionFit: Printers' units of measure share the name of a German river.

clue.text: It's not bound to sell

parts.note: not bound seems to mean under no obligation, but means sold as loose pages without a binding

explanation.definitionFit: Printed music is sold as unbound loose leaves rather than as a bound book.

clue.text: Suddenly expire, having snuffed it?

parts.note: expire and snuffed it suggest death, but mean a sharp breathing out after taking snuff

explanation.definitionFit: An involuntary explosive expulsion of breath, often caused by inhaling snuff.

clue.text: Of Peruvian ancestry? Brilliant!

parts.note: the Incas ruled ancient Peru, so Incan means Peruvian
descent is ancestry or lineage

explanation.surface: An excited reaction to learning someone has Peruvian forebears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Of' is a link: 'Of Peruvian ancestry' reads as being of Incan descent.
explanation.definitionFit: Incandescent means glowing with heat, hence brilliantly bright.

clue.text: Fill cracks with filler or stopper, say

indicators.note: say means the word for a stopper is to be spoken and spelt another way

parts.note: a cork is a bottle stopper

explanation.surface: Advice to plug gaps with some filler or a bung.
explanation.definitionFit: To caulk is to seal seams or cracks with a waterproof filler.

clue.text: Sphere of the dance?

explanation.definitionFit: It is a round object and also a grand formal dance.

clue.text: Party rising in power in old Scandinavia

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the word is read upwards, back to front

parts.note: a do is a party
taken as written

explanation.surface: A political party gains ground in ancient Scandinavia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' reverses DO to OD. 'power' means a deity, not political influence.
explanation.definitionFit: Odin was the chief god of Norse mythology, a divine power of the old Scandinavians.

clue.text: Being rich, packed it in

definitions.meaning: wealthy, slang for having plenty of money

explanation.definitionFit: Slang for very wealthy, and also meaning filled with a load.

clue.text: It fully inspires the love of children

definitions.text: It fully inspires the love of children

parts.words: It fully inspires the love of children
parts.note: a full larder wins affection, the self-interested love the phrase about food describes

explanation.definitionFit: Cupboard love is affection shown only for what one can get, such as food from a stocked larder.

clue.text: Turned key and pulled

indicators.note: turned means these letters are twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone turned a key and then gave the door a tug.
explanation.definitionFit: Yanked means pulled sharply and suddenly.

clue.text: It was a stronghold of Communism

definitions.text: It was a stronghold of Communism

parts.words: It was a stronghold of Communism
parts.note: a stronghold is a fortress, read both as a citadel and as the seat of Soviet power

explanation.definitionFit: The Moscow citadel was the seat of the Soviet Communist government.
